tools.title: Roth vs Traditional IRA Comparison
tools.description: Compare simplified after-tax balances using current and future tax assumptions.
tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"ira",n:"Roth vs Traditional IRA Comparison",c:"Retirement & investing",desc:"Compare simplified after-tax balances using current and future tax assumptions.",f:[["contribution","Annual contribution budget",7000],["years","Years invested",25],["rate","Assumed annual return (%)",6],["currentTax","Current tax rate (%)",22],["futureTax","Future tax rate (%)",22]],run:v=>{const x=Core.iraComparison(v.contribution,v.years,v.rate,v.currentTax,v.futureTax);return{main:fmt(x.rothAfterTax),assetValue:x.rothAfterTax,label:"ROTH ILLUSTRATIVE AFTER-TAX VALUE",metrics:[["Traditional balance before tax",fmt(x.traditionalBalance)],["Traditional after-tax value",fmt(x.traditionalAfterTax)],["Roth after-tax value",fmt(x.rothAfterTax)],["Roth minus traditional",fmt(x.difference)]],series:[x.traditionalAfterTax,x.rothAfterTax],chartLabels:["Traditional after-tax","Roth after-tax"],chartType:"bar",note:x.note,schedule:{monthly:x.monthlySchedule,yearly:x.yearlySchedule,comparison:{...x.traditionalSchedule,label:"Traditional after-tax"},label:"Roth after-tax"}}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function iraComparison(c,y,r,ct,ft){nonnegative(c,"Annual contribution");positive(y,"Years");nonnegative(r,"Return");if(ct>100||ft>100||y>100)throw Error("Tax rates must be 0–100 and years at most 100");const n=months(y*12),q=r/1200,m=c/12;let t=0,o=0,monthlySchedule=[],traditionalRows=[];for(let k=1;k<=n;k++){const rothOpen=o,tradOpen=t,rothInterest=rothOpen*q,tradInterest=tradOpen*q;o=rothOpen+rothInterest+m*(1-ct/100);t=tradOpen+tradInterest+m;monthlySchedule.push({month:k,openingBalance:rothOpen,payment:m*(1-ct/100),principal:m*(1-ct/100),interest:rothInterest,closingBalance:o});traditionalRows.push({month:k,openingBalance:tradOpen*(1-ft/100),payment:m*(1-ft/100),principal:m*(1-ft/100),interest:tradInterest*(1-ft/100),closingBalance:t*(1-ft/100)})}return{traditionalBalance:t,traditionalAfterTax:t*(1-ft/100),rothBalance:o,rothAfterTax:o,difference:o-t*(1-ft/100),annualContribution:c,months:n,monthlySchedule,yearlySchedule:yearlyProjection(monthlySchedule,["payment","principal","interest"]),traditionalSchedule:{monthly:traditionalRows,yearly:yearlyProjection(traditionalRows,["payment","principal","interest"])},note:"Simplified comparison assumes equal gross annual contribution budgets, current tax savings are not reinvested, and future tax applies to the traditional balance. Eligibility, limits and tax law are not modeled."}}

tools.title: Inflation Calculator
tools.description: Estimate how prices and purchasing power change under constant assumed inflation.
tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"inflation",n:"Inflation Calculator",c:"Everyday finance",desc:"Estimate how prices and purchasing power change under constant assumed inflation.",f:[["amount","Current cost / amount",1000],["rate","Annual inflation (%)",3],["years","Number of years",10]],run:v=>{const x=Core.inflationCalculator(v.amount,v.rate,v.years);const n=Math.min(61,Math.max(2,Math.round(v.years)+1));return{main:fmt(x.futureCost),label:"ESTIMATED FUTURE COST",metrics:[["Current amount",fmt(v.amount)],["Estimated cost increase",fmt(x.costIncrease)],["Cumulative increase",num(x.increasePercent)+"%"],["Future purchasing power",fmt(x.purchasingPower)]],series:Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>v.amount*Math.pow(1+v.rate/100,v.years*i/(n-1))),note:x.note}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function inflationCalculator(a,r,y){nonnegative(a,"Amount");nonnegative(r,"Inflation");nonnegative(y,"Years");if(y>100||r>1000)throw Error("Years or rate outside supported range");const f=a*Math.pow(1+r/100,y),p=a/Math.pow(1+r/100,y);return{futureCost:f,purchasingPower:p,costIncrease:f-a,increasePercent:a?(f/a-1)*100:0,note:"Assumes constant annual inflation. Actual inflation varies over time and by spending category."}}

tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"cd",n:"CD Calculator",c:"Savings & growth",desc:"Estimate certificate-of-deposit maturity value and interest from a fixed APY and term.",f:[["principal","Initial deposit",10000],["apy","Certificate APY (%)",4.5],["term","Term (months)",12]],run:v=>{const x=Core.certificateDeposit(v.principal,v.apy,v.term);return{main:fmt(x.futureValue),label:"ESTIMATED MATURITY VALUE",metrics:[["Initial deposit",fmt(x.principal)],["Interest earned",fmt(x.interestEarned)],["APY",num(x.apy)+"%"],["Term",x.months+" months"]],series:[v.principal,x.futureValue],breakdown:[{item:"Initial deposit",value:fmt(x.principal)},{item:"APY",value:num(x.apy)+"%"},{item:"Term",value:x.months+" months"},{item:"Interest earned",value:fmt(x.interestEarned)},{item:"Maturity value",value:fmt(x.futureValue)}],note:x.note}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function certificateDeposit(p,a,m){nonnegative(p,"Deposit");nonnegative(a,"APY");positive(m,"Term months");if(a>1000||m>1200||!Number.isInteger(m))throw Error("APY must be at most 1,000 percent and term must be a whole number of months");const f=p*Math.pow(1+a/100,m/12);return{futureValue:f,interestEarned:f-p,principal:p,apy:a,months:Math.round(m),note:"Assumes fixed APY for the full term, with no withdrawals, fees or early-withdrawal penalty."}}

tools.title: APY Calculator
tools.description: Convert nominal annual interest and compounding frequency into annual percentage yield.
tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"apy",n:"APY Calculator",c:"Savings & growth",desc:"Convert nominal annual interest and compounding frequency into annual percentage yield.",f:[["principal","Starting deposit",10000],["rate","Nominal annual rate (%)",4.25],["frequency","Compounding periods per year",12]],run:v=>{const x=Core.apyCalculator(v.principal,v.rate,v.frequency);return{main:num(x.apy,4)+"%",label:"ANNUAL PERCENTAGE YIELD (APY)",metrics:[["Starting deposit",fmt(v.principal)],["One-year interest",fmt(x.interestEarned)],["One-year balance",fmt(x.balance)],["Rate per period",num(x.periodicRate,5)+"%"]],breakdown:[{item:"Starting deposit",value:fmt(v.principal)},{item:"Nominal annual rate",value:num(v.rate)+"%"},{item:"Compounding periods",value:String(x.compoundingPeriods)},{item:"Rate per period",value:num(x.periodicRate,5)+"%"},{item:"APY",value:num(x.apy,4)+"%"},{item:"One-year interest",value:fmt(x.interestEarned)},{item:"One-year balance",value:fmt(x.balance)}],note:x.note}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function apyCalculator(p,r,f){nonnegative(p,"Principal");nonnegative(r,"Nominal rate");positive(f,"Compounding periods");if(r>1000||f>365||!Number.isInteger(f))throw Error("Rate must be at most 1,000 percent and compounding frequency must be a whole number");const n=Math.round(f),q=r/100/n,b=p*Math.pow(1+q,n),apy=(Math.pow(1+q,n)-1)*100;return{apy,balance:b,interestEarned:b-p,periodicRate:q*100,compoundingPeriods:n,note:"Assumes a fixed nominal rate compounded at the selected frequency for one year. Fees and changing rates are excluded."}}

tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"tax",n:"Tax Calculator",c:"Tax & income",desc:"Estimate tax after a flat tax rate and entered credits.",f:[["amount","Taxable income / amount",50000],["rate","Estimated tax rate (%)",20],["credits","Tax credits",1000]],run:v=>{const x=Core.taxEstimate(v.amount,v.rate,v.credits);return{main:fmt(x.tax),label:"ESTIMATED TAX AFTER CREDITS",metrics:[["Tax before credits",fmt(x.grossTax)],["Credits applied",fmt(x.creditsApplied)],["After-tax amount",fmt(x.afterTax)],["Effective tax rate",num(x.effectiveRate)+"%"]],breakdown:[{item:"Taxable amount",value:fmt(v.amount)},{item:"Flat tax rate",value:num(v.rate)+"%"},{item:"Tax before credits",value:fmt(x.grossTax)},{item:"Credits applied",value:fmt(x.creditsApplied)},{item:"Estimated tax",value:fmt(x.tax)},{item:"After-tax amount",value:fmt(x.afterTax)}],note:x.note}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function taxEstimate(amount,rate,credits=0){nonnegative(amount,"Taxable amount");nonnegative(rate,"Tax rate");nonnegative(credits,"Tax credits");if(rate>100)throw Error("Tax rate must not exceed 100 percent");const grossTax=amount*rate/100,tax=Math.max(0,grossTax-credits);return{grossTax,creditsApplied:Math.min(grossTax,credits),tax,afterTax:amount-tax,effectiveRate:amount===0?0:tax/amount*100,note:"Uses the single tax rate and tax credits you enter. It is not a jurisdiction-specific tax return."}}

tools.description: Calculate sales tax, discounts and final checkout total.
tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"sales-tax",n:"Sales Tax Calculator",c:"Tax & income",desc:"Calculate sales tax, discounts and final checkout total.",f:[["subtotal","Subtotal / tax-inclusive total",120],["discount","Discount (%)",10],["rate","Sales tax rate (%)",8.25],["mode","Subtotal mode","add","select",["add","included"]]],run:v=>{const x=Core.salesTax(v.subtotal,v.discount,v.rate,v.mode);return{main:fmt(x.finalTotal),label:"ESTIMATED FINAL TOTAL",metrics:[["Pre-discount amount",fmt(x.originalSubtotal)],["Discount",fmt(x.discount)],["Taxable amount",fmt(x.taxableAmount)],["Sales tax",fmt(x.tax)],["Final total",fmt(x.finalTotal)]],breakdown:[{item:"Pre-discount base",value:fmt(x.originalSubtotal)},{item:"Discount",value:fmt(x.discount)},{item:"Taxable amount",value:fmt(x.taxableAmount)},{item:"Sales tax",value:fmt(x.tax)},{item:"Final total",value:fmt(x.finalTotal)}],note:x.note}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function salesTax(subtotal,discountPct,rate,mode="add"){nonnegative(subtotal,"Subtotal");nonnegative(discountPct,"Discount percent");nonnegative(rate,"Sales tax rate");if(discountPct>100||rate>100)throw Error("Discount and tax rates must not exceed 100 percent");const base=mode==="included"?subtotal/(1+rate/100):subtotal,discount=base*discountPct/100,taxable=base-discount,tax=taxable*rate/100,total=taxable+tax;return{originalSubtotal:base,discount,taxableAmount:taxable,tax,total,finalTotal:total,preTaxTotal:taxable,note:mode==="included"?"Input subtotal is treated as tax-inclusive before discount; tax is recalculated after discount.":"Sales tax is added after discount. Exemptions and local rules are not modeled."}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function vatGst(amount,rate,mode="add"){nonnegative(amount,"Amount");nonnegative(rate,"VAT/GST rate");if(rate>100)throw Error("VAT/GST rate must not exceed 100 percent");if(mode==="remove"){const base=amount/(1+rate/100),tax=amount-base;return{base,tax,total:amount,mode,note:"Extracts tax included in the entered gross amount."}}const tax=amount*rate/100;return{base:amount,tax,total:amount+tax,mode:"add",note:"Adds the entered VAT/GST rate to the net amount. Actual registration, exemptions and place-of-supply rules vary."}}

tools.runtimeDefinition: {id:"break-even",n:"Break-even Calculator",c:"Freelance & business",desc:"Estimate unit sales and revenue needed to cover fixed and variable costs.",f:[["fixed","Total fixed costs",12000],["price","Selling price per unit",50],["variable","Variable cost per unit",20]],run:v=>{const x=Core.breakEvenCalculator(v.fixed,v.price,v.variable);return{main:num(x.units,0)+" units",label:"BREAK-EVEN SALES VOLUME",metrics:[["Contribution per unit",fmt(x.contribution)],["Contribution margin",num(x.contributionMargin)+"%"],["Exact break-even units",num(x.unitsExact,2)],["Whole units required",num(x.units,0)],["Break-even revenue",fmt(x.revenue)],["Total costs",fmt(x.totalCosts)]],series:x.series,chartLabels:["Fixed costs","Variable costs","Revenue at break-even"],chartType:"bar",breakdown:[{item:"Fixed costs",value:fmt(v.fixed)},{item:"Contribution per unit",value:fmt(x.contribution)},{item:"Exact break-even quantity",value:num(x.unitsExact,3)},{item:"Whole units required",value:num(x.units,0)},{item:"Revenue at break-even",value:fmt(x.revenue)},{item:"Total costs at break-even",value:fmt(x.totalCosts)}],note:x.note,seo:{intro:"Calculate contribution per unit, break-even volume and revenue using your fixed costs, selling price and variable cost.",faqs:[["What is contribution per unit?","Selling price per unit minus variable cost per unit."],["Why round units up?","A business generally cannot sell a fraction of a unit, so the practical target rounds up."],["Are taxes included?","No. Financing, tax, product mix and capacity constraints are excluded."]]}}}}

calculationImplementation.sourceCode: function breakEvenCalculator(fixed,price,variable){[fixed,price,variable].forEach(v=>nonnegative(v,"Break-even input"));if(price<=variable)throw Error("Selling price must exceed variable cost per unit to produce a break-even volume");const contribution=price-variable,exact=fixed===0?0:fixed/contribution,units=Math.ceil(exact),revenue=units*price,variableCosts=units*variable;return{contribution,contributionMargin:price?contribution/price*100:0,unitsExact:exact,units,revenue,variableCosts,totalCosts:fixed+variableCosts,series:[fixed,variableCosts,revenue],note:"Whole units are rounded up. Assumes constant price, variable cost and fixed costs; product mix and capacity are excluded."}}
